items.name: Finnish FMC Series X 2025
items.information: **This is an FMC only competition. No speedsolving events will be held.** Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor. **Tämän kisan ainoa laji on vähiten siirtoja. Speedsolving -lajeja ei pidetä.** Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua. Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.

venue.name: Colegio Viña de Jesus
venue.address: Calle Cuevo, esq 598, Santa Cruz de la Sierra

items.information: This is the fifth edition of Viña Cubing Fest, and it will be recognized as the first regional championship of Santa Cruz de la Sierra. All competitors from across the country are welcome to participate, but only residents of Santa Cruz department will be eligible to earn the title of "Campeon Cruceño", awarded to the first place winner in each event. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VinaCubingFestVSC2025#63212-instrucciones-de-pago) **More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VinaCubingFestVSC2025#63211-faq-pmf)** Esta es la quinta edición de Viña Cubing Fest, y será considerado el primer campeonato regional de Santa Cruz de la Sierra. Todos los competidores a nivel nacional son bienvenidos a participar, pero solo los residentes del departamento de Santa Cruz serán elegibles para recibir el título de Campeón Cruceño, otorgado al primer lugar de cada categoría. Para ver la informacion acerca del pago de inscripcion entra al siguiente [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VinaCubingFestVSC2025#63212-instrucciones-de-pago) **Mas informacion acerca de las competencias ingresar a: [Preguntas frecuentes / FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VinaCubingFestVSC2025#63211-faq-pmf)** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTM0MjE0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bd94dc590324cf6af4375b4340574f73be20010c/f8202515-56e1-484c-8d58-ee3e69216109.jpeg) Esta competencia cuenta con el apoyo de: [Qiyi Toys] (https://www.facebook.com/share/17BKDA1ajf/) [Agua VillaSanta](https://www.facebook.com/share/1CvFyCK3RU/) [Pollos El Solar](https://www.facebook.com/share/1BZYcBwSyb/) [Direccion Municipal de Deportes y Juventud](https://www.facebook.com/share/1Ba1arenaS/) [Mendocina](https://www.facebook.com/share/19bc9UqjxA/) [KrazyCubes](https://www.facebook.com/share/1JB3WQ66tm/) [KrazyCubes] (https://krazycubes-bolivia.com/) El Colegio [La Viña de Jesús](https://lavinadejesus.com/plataformas/) y [la Asociación Juvenil Cruceña del Cubo de Rubik](https://www.facebook.com/share/1HmBBmse4B/).
